acceptance: On the cycles 2044 to 2046 fixture, the cache-read total is 26.25 M, equal to the row sum.
--by phase,profile,purpose splits the total with no remainder.
A wave with no landed cycle prints M2 as not defined, not as 0.
The report prints the share of unmeasured rows.
The default weights give 97.0 CWU on the waves 141 to 143 fixture.
fix: Make the report read llm-calls.ndjson of each cycle, join the cycle outcome from run.json and the ship result, and print the metrics M1 to M6 of the plan: CWU with the policy weights of each family, CWU for each shipped cycle, the cache-hit ratio, tokens of each phase for each shipped cycle, the quota percent for each wave from the usage history, and the waste shares. Add --by phase,profile,purpose,step. Read cyclespend.Sum (PR #1184) for the cycle totals. Keep the phase-timing view as --source timing until enforce.
